boundary_decision.rationale: The slash label is resolved as a regulatory declaration or disclosure and delivery aggregate. It owns the versioned reporting package, submission or dissemination attempts and attributable acknowledgements, while reporting entities, obligations, law, domain facts, regulator findings, decisions, sanctions and records remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: The model owns disclosure revisions, delivery or dissemination attempts and acknowledgements, not every upstream domain fact or downstream regulatory lifecycle.
The registry supplies WM-REC-002 as a parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-033 edge, so it grants no containment or cascade authority.

decisions.concept: Disclosure revision, delivery attempt, dissemination event and acknowledgement
decisions.rationale: A revision states assertions, an attempt delivers one payload, dissemination makes content available and a response records a correlated outcome.

decisions.concept: Prepared, approved, signed, submitted, received, valid, accepted, published and reviewed
decisions.rationale: No preparation, approval, transport, validation or publication state silently proves regulator agreement, compliance or finality.

decisions.concept: Reported assertion, regulator finding, legal fact, compliance and sanction
decisions.rationale: Reported content retains source and authority and does not become a regulator finding or legal conclusion merely through validation or acceptance.

decisions.concept: Periodic, event-driven, initial, amended, restated, replacement, withdrawal and nil filing
decisions.rationale: Each class has different triggers, periods, deadlines, legal effects, lineage and downstream processing.

decisions.concept: Amendment, correction, restatement, replacement and withdrawal
decisions.rationale: The disclosed predecessor remains immutable while a successor states the change set, reason, authority and downstream impact.

decisions.concept: Reporting entity, obligation, law, domain data, case, decision and sanction
decisions.rationale: The filing binds or projects these records but does not absorb their identity, authority or lifecycle.

decisions.concept: Regulator, sector, jurisdiction, form, taxonomy, schema and channel
decisions.rationale: Official sources define scoped releases; no form, deadline, validation, signature or delivery effect is universal.

decisions.concept: Confidentiality, public disclosure, privacy and access
decisions.rationale: Public, confidential, restricted and personal assertions require explicit classification, audience, purpose, least privilege and auditable exceptions.
XML, XBRL, iXBRL, CSV, JSON, APIs, portals, files and databases are projections of the same logical model and must declare profile versions and loss.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-REC-002 parent signal and register relations to reporting entity, regulator, obligation, law, domain data, permit, application, case, decision, assessment, sanction, payment and records models.
Evaluate separate canonical disclosure-revision, filing-attempt, dissemination-event, acknowledgement, regulator-finding and decision models while preserving this aggregate as an assembly.
Create securities, prudential, insurance, statistics, safety, environmental, health, data-protection, utilities, transport, customs and other regulator profiles.
Benchmark and conformance-test forms, schemas, taxonomies, validation rules, signatures, deadlines, channels, acknowledgements, amendments and restatement mappings.
Validate jurisdiction, regulator, sector, reporting-entity class, obligation, public-disclosure, confidentiality, privacy, investigation, sanction and retention policies.
Pin exact external releases and obtain independent regulatory, legal, sector, compliance, privacy, security, records and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-033 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Slash-boundary hold: this aggregate covers disclosure revisions, delivery or dissemination attempts and acknowledgements, while upstream domain facts and downstream regulator lifecycles remain external.
Relation hold: WM-REC-002 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-033 edge.
Identity hold: reporting entity, obligation, filing revision, attempt, dissemination, acknowledgement, finding, decision, sanction and records objects remain distinct.
Lifecycle hold: prepared, reviewed, approved, signed, submitted, received, valid, accepted-for-processing, published, regulator-reviewed, compliant and final states do not prove one another.
Assertion hold: reported content, validation result, regulator finding, accepted legal fact, assessment, compliance state and sanction remain separately sourced and authority-qualified.
Correction hold: amendments, corrections, restatements, replacements and withdrawals preserve predecessors and declare downstream obligations rather than overwriting history.
Confidentiality hold: public, confidential, restricted, personal, market-sensitive, security and investigation data require explicit classification, purpose and minimum disclosure.
Source-access hold: direct automated access to two EBA pages failed; their current official indexed content was used and exact release files still need conformance verification.
Profile hold: securities, prudential, insurance, statistics, safety, environment, health, data-protection, utilities, transport and customs reporting need separate profiles.
Interoperability hold: every reporting, identity, signature, privacy, temporal, provenance, quality, policy and API projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: regulatory, legal, sector, compliance, privacy, security, records and independent external review are outstanding.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
